notes_for_editor: Only the list entry names this site. The Forest Lookouts page covers a single South Mills entry headed (NEW), with a 1944 tower and a 2018 surplus auction; no page or source found covers an older tower. Legeros says a Knightdale tower went to South Mills but not to which site, so it is not attributed here. The 1944 tower may or may not be this one; the story does not assign it. The story is short because nothing else is supported. No source describes the site now or public access.
